messages:
Maria L.: Hey folks — linkcheck started failing on CI after the localization merge. Build says "anchor not found: migration#step-2" but the MD link is `../migration#step-2` and renders fine locally.

Docs-ci: buildkite/job/12345 failed · linkcheck

Kevin T.: hmm, could be ZWSP/soft-hyphen in heading id. We ran into this before with copy/paste from Google Sheets. Quick check: `git grep -n $'\u200B' || true`

Sanjay P.: I'll triage. If it's a stray unicode char we can strip it in a patch. Also will check mkdocs slugify rules — material changed behavior in 8.x.

Olivia R.: fwiw Docusaurus slugifier will collapse punctuation differently. If anyone mixed conventions during the migration we'll get mismatched anchors.

Sanjay P.: created a tiny branch and pushed a script. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4321 — removes zero-width chars and normalizes header ids.

Kevin T.: nice. Could we add a unit test to the docs CI that runs a slugify comparator? Catch these automatically.

Sanjay P.: good idea. Adding a linkcheck-only job that runs `python -c "from mkdocs.utils import slugify; print(slugify('…'))"` and compares generated anchors.

Maria L.: thanks — any ETA on the PR? There's a support ticket blocked on this.

Sanjay P.: Should be up in 20min. I'll also re-run the failing build once merged.

deploy-bot: re-run requested by @Sanjay P. — queued

Docs-ci: linkcheck rerun: now passes ✅

Maria L.: confirmed the support case can move forward. Thanks everyone :tada:

Olivia R.: follow-up: opened a small docs guide note about consistent heading sanitization and avoiding invisible chars. Will link from migration guide.

Kevin T.: can we add a pre-commit hook to strip U+200B on save? simple `pre-commit` hook would help.

Sanjay P.: added pre-commit entry in PR

Maria L.: great. closing the loop here — marking as fixed in the migration checklist.
